data.title: 电影散场前的暗场手心
data.location: 片尾字幕亮起的复古影院后排
data.lighting: 银幕冷白微光侧照与影厅深暗红椅
data.camera: 扶手与侧颜贴近斜角近景
data.prompt: 1girl, solo, shiki_natsume, ivory fitted cashmere turtleneck sweater, black high-waist skirt, sitting in dark cinema velvet seat, eyes fixed toward off-screen movie screen, pinky finger quietly hooking viewer hand on shared armrest, subtle rose blush, calm profile, dimmed movie theater, rows of crimson plush seats, cool silver-blue projector beam and screen glow illuminating her face and hair, deep theater shadows, side angle, medium close-up
data.animaCaption: Keeping her gaze coolly trained on the rolling end credits in the dark cinema, she quietly hooks her pinky around yours on the shared velvet armrest. Cool silver-blue screen light washes gently across her ivory turtleneck and softly flushed profile.
data.promptProse: Captured closely from the adjoining crimson velvet seat inside a hushed movie theater during the end credits, Shiki Natsume wears her sleek ivory cashmere turtleneck and black skirt. She keeps her posture composed and her eyes pointed steadily toward the glowing screen ahead, yet lets her hand slide across the dark armrest until her pinky lightly links with the viewer's fingers. Cool blue-white light flickers softly from the screen across her cheek, lashes, and red hairclips while the empty rows behind fall into deep burgundy shadow.
data.story: 影厅里的片尾字幕一行行往上滚动，前排观众陆续起身离场。夏目依然目不转睛地望着银幕，搭在绒面扶手上的指尖却悄悄挪过来勾住你的小指，声音轻得几乎盖过配乐——「别急着走……我想把主题曲听完。」
